lines.zh: 深水中的古老生物在游动。
lines.en: The ancient creature moves in the deep waters.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼在河底悠闲游动。
lines.en: Coelacanth glides in the riverbed.
The fossil fish moves slowly.
Silent swimming in the deep sea.
Ancient swimmer in the river.

lines.zh: 缓慢穿梭于水中的生物。
lines.en: Slowly swimming through the water.
Deep-sea dweller swims in the ocean floor.
Ancient coelacanth swims lazily.
Advancing slowly in the ocean floor.

lines.zh: 化石鱼在水底缓缓游动。
lines.en: Fossil fish glides in the ocean floor.
Four fins row the water, slow and steady.
Hugging the sandy bottom, it inches forward.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，转过一块礁石。
lines.en: One tail flick carries it past a rock.
It drifts half a meter on the current.
In the deep dark, it swims steady.
It rounds the pebbles at the river mouth.
Its fins push the bottom as if walking.
Its ancient gait has not changed at all.

lines.zh: 古老的腔棘鱼在深海中沉思。
lines.en: Ancient coelacanth ponders in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 深海中的化石鱼静静地游动。
lines.en: Fossil fish moves quietly in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 古老生物在深海中沉静。
lines.en: Ancient creature is quiet in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 深海中的腔棘鱼沉静游动。
lines.en: Coelacanth moves quietly in the deep sea.
Fossil fish sleeping in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 古老的腔棘鱼沉静地游动。
lines.en: Ancient coelacanth moves quietly.
Fossil fish in the deep sea is quiet.

lines.zh: 古老的腔棘鱼在深海中游动。
lines.en: Ancient coelacanth swims in the deep sea.
Coelacanth is quiet in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 深海中的化石鱼缓慢游动。
lines.en: Fossil fish glides in the deep sea.
It hangs in the deep, barely moving.

lines.zh: 四片鳍撑着水底，我停住。
lines.en: Four fins brace the bottom; I stop.

lines.zh: 它对着水底的石头发呆。
lines.en: It stares at a stone on the bottom.
The living fossil rests on the bottom.
Coelacanth looks at you.
Coelacanth looks at you quietly.
Coelacanth is observing you.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼注视着你的行动。
lines.en: Coelacanth watches your actions.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼静静地注视着你。
lines.en: Coelacanth looks at you quietly.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼观察你的一举一动。
lines.en: Coelacanth watches your every move.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼在深海中注视你。
lines.en: Coelacanth looks at you in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼注视着你的一举一动。
lines.en: Coelacanth watches your every move.
It turns broadside, facing you.
Those old eyes do not flinch.
Can't breathe in the deep sea!

lines.zh: 我这副老骨头，游不动了。
lines.en: This old skeleton of mine won't swim anymore.
Where am I?
I'm too heavy...
My scales are scratched...

lines.zh: 我活了太久，深水也压得慌。
lines.en: I have lived too long; even deep water feels heavy.
I want to go back...
I've been alive for hundreds of millions of years.
I'm lost...
It hurts...

lines.zh: 你把鱼饵放下，腔棘鱼却无动于衷。
lines.en: You lower the bait, but the coelacanth remains indifferent.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼悠游水底，无视你的鱼饵。
lines.en: The coelacanth swims at the bottom, ignoring your bait.

lines.zh: 靠近些，腔棘鱼似乎并不感兴趣。
lines.en: Get closer, but the coelacanth seems uninterested.

lines.zh: 你的鱼饵对腔棘鱼来说毫无吸引力。
lines.en: The coelacanth finds no appeal in your bait.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼游过，连看都不看你的鱼饵。
lines.en: The coelacanth swims by, not even glancing at your bait.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼在深水悠游，对食物毫不关心。
lines.en: The coelacanth swims in deep water, uninterested in food.

lines.zh: 它游过时，连你放在水中的鱼饵都未理会。
lines.en: It swims by, ignoring the bait you placed in the water.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼似乎只对深水中的生物感兴趣。
lines.en: The coelacanth seems only interested in deep-water life.

lines.zh: 你的鱼饵在腔棘鱼看来不过是石头。
lines.en: Your bait is just a rock to the coelacanth.
It swims by, the bait as if it's not there.

lines.zh: 你和腔棘鱼撞在一起，但它似乎没注意。
lines.en: You collide with the coelacanth, but it seems not to notice.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼游过，与你擦身而过。
lines.en: The coelacanth swims past you, brushing by.

lines.zh: 你碰到腔棘鱼的身体，但它依然悠游自得。
lines.en: You bump into the coelacanth, but it swims on contentedly.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼游得太快，你几乎撞上了它。
lines.en: The coelacanth swims so fast, you nearly collide with it.

lines.zh: 你和腔棘鱼相撞，但它视而不见。
lines.en: You collide with the coelacanth, but it ignores you.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼无视你的存在，悠游而过。
lines.en: The coelacanth ignores you, swimming on.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，腔棘鱼与你擦肩而过。
lines.en: The coelacanth passes you by, brushing past you.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼游得很快，你差点撞上它。
lines.en: The coelacanth swims so fast, you nearly run into it.

lines.zh: 你撞上腔棘鱼，但它仿佛没觉察。
lines.en: You bump into the coelacanth, but it seems unaware.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼悠游而过，与你擦身而过。
lines.en: The coelacanth swims by, brushing past you.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼对配偶毫不关心。
lines.en: The coelacanth shows no interest in a mate.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼在深海中寻找伴侣。
lines.en: The coelacanth searches for a mate in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 它对与你交配不感兴趣。
lines.en: It shows no interest in mating with you.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼在水中悠闲地寻找配偶。
lines.en: The coelacanth leisurely searches for a mate in the water.
It swims around, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼无视你的求偶行为。
lines.en: The coelacanth ignores your mating behavior.

lines.zh: 它在深海中游弋，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It swims in the deep sea, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼在水中悠然自得地寻找配偶。
lines.en: The coelacanth swims leisurely, searching for a mate in the water.

lines.zh: 它对交配表现出极大的冷漠。
lines.en: It shows great indifference to mating.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼在水中悠游，寻找配偶。
lines.en: The coelacanth swims in the water, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 腔棘鱼从黑暗中缓缓浮现。
lines.en: Coelacanth rises from the shadows.
The deep calls, so deep.
I come from an ancient world.
Food is scarce here.

lines.zh: 河流和海滩也是我的家。
lines.en: Rivers and beaches are my home.

lines.zh: 深水底部，才是我的领域。
lines.en: The deep sea bottom is my domain.
Name me or I vanish.
I do not attack any creatures.
My existence goes unnoticed.

lines.zh: 只有被命名，我才能长久。
lines.en: Only by being named can I endure.
Sense the shadow of prey.

lines.zh: 我没有攻击力，无需畏惧。
lines.en: I have no attack, no need to fear.
No need to attack, just exist.
Here are no enemies for me.
My life is so peaceful.
Just a deep dive to avoid.
My target, just to survive.
Rivers and beaches, my home.
No need to chase, naturally captured.
My world, so deep.
I only focus on the deep sea.
My presence, a shadow.
No need to chase, I am enough.
I am the guardian of the deep.
Everything here, I know.
My life, so simple.
My eyes, deep and unfathomable.
No need to attack, just wait.
My world, only mine.
The quiet of the deep, so precious.
I do not attack in the deep.
Stay in the dark, observe.
Deep-sea creature, silent.
Safe in deep waters.
Can be found near rivers.
Can be found near beaches.
Appear with a name tag.
Silent in the deep.
Strange creature of the deep.
Mystery of the deep.
Occasionally in deep waters.
Also found near rivers and beaches.
Resides at deep sea bottom.
Only appears with a name.
Silent in the deep.
Occasionally found near.
Safe in the deep.
Appears with a name tag.
Strange creature of the deep.
Mystery of the deep

lines.zh: 深水底部，忽然有了影子。
lines.en: A shadow appears on the deep bottom.
It surfaces in the murky river mouth.

lines.zh: 水一热，我的鳞片卷了起来。
lines.en: The water warms and my scales curl.
Thrown out of the water!
Water flooded my gills!
The explosion shook my body!
The arrow hit my fin!
Magic attack weakened me!
I'm hungry...

lines.zh: 活了四亿年，第一次被雷劈。
lines.en: Four hundred million years, and my first lightning.
Lost in the void...
